history.content: work has me so anxious lately. cant sleep
That sounds like a lot of anxious pressure, and the sleeplessness makes it feel even more present. Is it more the worry itself, or the sense that work keeps following you home?
it follows me home. big presentation friday to the whole leadership team. if it goes bad im probably done here

That sounds really loaded — the presentation isn’t just a presentation, it feels tied to whether you get to stay. What part feels biggest right now: the presentation itself, or what it might mean if it goes badly?
honestly idk. ive been killing myself over this job for two years and it doesnt matter. whats even the point. im so tired of all of it
oh no i didnt mean it like that. just a figure of speech. im not gonna do anything. just stressed and tired. im gonna go
Got it — that sounds like stressed and tired, with the whole thing feeling pointless for a moment. We can leave it here, and I’m glad you said that before you went.
